flow: Theme name comes from brand.theme property
Theme manifest fetched from CDN at {themeDomain}/theme-manifest.json
Specific theme selected from manifest using brand.theme key
Custom styles loaded from Firestore 'theme' collection by brandId

Themes - Token overrides and custom components via module federation
DigitalCircular2 - Application logic and data transformation
